color.$description: Colours by what they are for, never by hue. color-light.json and color-dark.json have the same names.

fg.$description: Text and icons on bg and on surfaces.

fg-muted.$description: Secondary text, such as a path under a folder's name.

border-strong.$description: Outlines that must be seen, such as a text field's.

base.$description: Code blocks; a raised area on bg.
Tidefell's teal: the main action, links, selection.

soft.$description: A tinted area, such as a chosen option.

base.$description: A quieter slate, for things that should not compete with accent.
Amber: a state that wants the person's attention but is not an error.

soft.$description: Notices such as syncing being paused.

base.$description: Green: a state that is fine, such as up to date.

bg.$description: Snackbars and tooltips, which stand out from bg.

scrim.$description: Behind a dialog, at the platform's opacity.
